symptom: A generated report concluded that a group of items showed 'coordinated rather than independent operation' — a claim about the actors the items describe. The items did agree, and every step that produced the conclusion ran correctly. The agreement had two causes, both internal to the system: the items were separate slices of one authored situation and therefore shared their named parties, and the uniform verdict they agreed on was fixed by a single configuration constant rather than measured per item. The report distinguished neither, because nothing it reads carries the distinction.
mechanism_as_described: Two mechanisms compose. First, the relation graph links two items whenever they name a party in common, and it has no notion of whether the two items are independent observations at all — a group of co-authored slices of one situation forms exactly the same shape as a group of genuinely distinct items, and is indistinguishable in kind from it. The step that merges duplicate links between the same pair keeps one label, so the fact that a pair shares BOTH a benefiting party AND a harmed party — the very thing that would mark them as one situation described twice — is not expressible at the level where the links live. Second, the per-item verdict that the group agrees on is not continuous: one authored role choice supplies a fixed number, and that number and its nearest alternative fall on opposite sides of the threshold where the verdict changes sign, so the verdict is a restatement of a discrete authoring decision. Because agreement produced by re-description and agreement produced by convergence look identical downstream, a step that counts agreement across links reports the first as the second.
detection_path: Two independent checks, both with their negative half constructed in advance. A fixture pair: three items written as slices of one situation (same benefiting party, same harmed party, near-identical magnitude) and three genuinely distinct items. The first formed the complete set of links; the second formed none — and it is the second that matters, because it establishes the empty result is the filter working rather than a probe that cannot return anything. Separately, a census over the live output computed for every item whether its authored role value and the nearest alternative role value sit on opposite sides of the sign threshold, using the parameter values as serialized in that same output rather than a copy: 103 of 105 items qualified, 98.1%. Items whose value matched no role constant were counted and surfaced as their own bucket rather than quietly dropped, so the rate could not be read as a share of everything.
consequence: For as long as the read stood, sets of items that were one authored situation described several times were reported as mutually corroborating, and a shared configuration constant was reported as coordinated behaviour by the parties described. The failure mode is specifically hard to see from the output: corroboration and re-description produce the same tallies, the same links, and the same confident sentence, and the sentence names something in the world rather than something about the data. A reader has no way to ask which one they are looking at.

alternatives_not_extracted: A ledger renderer read the wrong serialized keys for its edge lines and printed placeholder marks where the identifier and strength should have been. Real, but it announced itself in the output as a visible placeholder rather than as a plausible value.

A fix was folded into a commit for unrelated work, and separately a pre-existing uncommitted change was swept into another commit by a broad staging command. Both were caught in review, one unpicked into its own commit with a two-sided witness and the other disclosed and left in place. NOT extracted because these are process defects caught at review, and the extracted one had reached generated output.

The step that merges duplicate links between a pair keeps a single label, so a pair sharing both a benefiting and a harmed party cannot be marked as such at that level. NOT extracted separately because it is a component of the extracted mechanism, and because the design worked around it rather than reporting it as a defect that produced a wrong result on its own.
